description:
The single entry point of the Extension DevKit. One tool, one `mode` argument, every DevKit operation.

Quick start — the four calls an LLM makes most:
  {"mode": "design", "domain": "data", "brief": "Query our warehouse"} — match a domain and return a full blueprint (runtime, tools, capabilities, grants, safety rules, build order, gates).
  {"mode": "scaffold", "path": "/abs/path/to/pkg", "id": "com.example.warehouse", "domain": "data", "brief": "Query our warehouse"} — write a validating package skeleton from that blueprint.
  {"mode": "check", "path": "/abs/path/to/pkg", "smoke": true} — validate + lint + hash + dry-run every declared tool in one report.
  {"mode": "publish", "path": "/abs/path/to/pkg", "action": "merge"} — write the package's entry into the market index.json.

All modes and their arguments:
  design     — domain, brief, id?, runtime?, path?  (default mode; returns a blueprint, optionally compared with an existing package at path)
  blueprint  — domain, brief, path (required), id?  — like design but also writes docs/design.md into the package
  scaffold   — path (required), id (required), domain?, brief?, runtime?, name?, description?, author?, license?, force?  — create a new package
  explain    — topic?  — return the BSH standard reference for one topic (manifest, capabilities, tools, market, ...); omit topic for the index
  validate   — path (required)  — parse and check one package, returns findings with rule ids
  lint       — path (required)  — validate plus review rules (EXT001..EXT120), returns findings with severity
  check      — path (required), smoke?, tool?, arguments?  — lint + hash + file count; smoke=true dry-runs every tool, tool="name" dry-runs one
  smoke      — path (required), tool?, arguments?  — dry-run declared tools locally
  publish    — path (required), action (entry|merge|verify|list|readme, default entry), repo?  — build/merge/verify a market index entry; merge writes index.json
  package    — path (required), out?  — build a deterministic .tar.gz release archive
  bump       — path (required), release (major|minor|patch|semver, default patch)  — raise the version and open a changelog entry
  hash       — path (required)  — print the canonical package hash the market index carries
  migrate    — path (required), write?  — rewrite a 1.x manifest as the 2.0 envelope
  events     — limit?  — report host events this process observed

Rules of thumb: every path is absolute (the process cwd is its own package); design before scaffold, scaffold before code; one build step per change, then check with smoke=true.

mode.description: Which DevKit operation to run. Omit for design. See the tool description for the argument each mode expects.

domain.description: Domain profile key (knowledge, devops, data, web, documents, media, messaging, security, research, model, system, generic) or a sentence naming the domain. Used by design, blueprint and scaffold.

brief.description: One or two sentences about what the extension should let the reader do. Used by design, blueprint and scaffold.

id.description: Reverse-domain extension id (e.g. com.example.toolkit). Required for scaffold; optional for design/blueprint (a suggestion is derived from the brief when omitted).

runtime.description: Override the profile's runtime recommendation (declarative = no code runs, process = the host starts server.py). Used by design, blueprint and scaffold.

path.description: Absolute path to a package directory. Required for blueprint, scaffold, validate, lint, check, smoke, publish, package, bump, hash and migrate; optional for design (compares the blueprint with the package on disk).

action.description: Market sub-action for mode=publish. entry (default) prints the index entry JSON; merge writes it into index.json; verify checks every entry against its directory and hash; list reads the index; readme rewrites the README package table.

release.description: Version bump for mode=bump: major, minor, patch (default) or an explicit semantic version like 2.1.0. Refuses a downgrade.

out.description: Absolute output directory for mode=package. Defaults to the package's parent; must not be inside the package.

repo.description: Absolute path to the market checkout (the clone that holds index.json). For mode=publish when the package path alone cannot locate it.

topic.description: Reference topic for mode=explain. Omit for the index of all topics; known topics include overview, manifest, capabilities, contributions, tools, panels, market, errors, checklist, domains, design, commands, skills, security, protocol, ids, workflows.

limit.description: Max recent events to return for mode=events (default 20).

smoke.description: For mode=check: run a dry-run smoke test of every declared tool.

tool.description: Name of one declared tool to dry-run (mode=check or mode=smoke). Naming a tool in check implies smoke.

arguments.description: Arguments object passed to the tool named by `tool` during a smoke run.

write.description: For mode=migrate: also rewrite extension.toml (a .v1 backup is kept). For mode=blueprint this is implied.

force.description: For mode=scaffold: write into a non-empty target directory.

name.description: Human-readable package name for mode=scaffold. Derived from the id when omitted.

description.description: One-line package description for mode=scaffold. Derived from the brief when omitted.

author.description: Author name written into the scaffolded manifest and LICENSE (default from configuration).
